newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil up $3 on futures, diesel tight and firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil up $3 on futures, diesel tight and firm.

text.p: NWE gas oil gained a further $3 a tonne on Wednesday on the back of stronger futures and steady premiums, consolidating the $3 a tonne gains made on Wednesday.
May IPE gas oil closed at $171.75 a tonne, up $3.

Traders said activity had been fairly sparse with most Dutch dealers absent because of a public holiday. Further public holidays throughout continental Europe on Thursday were shortening the week, traders said.
Premiums held steady with heating oil barges heard concluded at May IPE +50 cents fob AR for first half May while diesel barges remained firm with May IPE +$12.50 fob AR concluded.
"Because it's been a thin market today the $12.50 was possible," said one dealer.
Supplies of diesel remain tight keeping offers at May IPE +$15 cif NWE and bids at May IPE +$13.50, although there was late talk of a buyer at May IPE +$14.00.
Heating oil markets saw DIN pegged around May IPE +$6-7 cif with FOD $1 below this.
